name: Mongolia
tagline: Gers, horses and a steppe with no fences. July and August are the only months it works, and Naadam opens the window.

access.route: Brussels→Ulaanbaatar via Istanbul (Turkish, 1 stop, 13 h) or via Frankfurt (MIAT)

whyNotes: The emptiest country on the page. Not Central Asia in the Silk Road sense: no bazaars, no Soviet-era towns, just the steppe, Buddhist monasteries and families who still move with the herds. Horses do the hiking's work when Mom wants a day off her feet.
fitNotes: Altitude 1,350–2,300 m on the main routes (Altai is higher and left out of the presets). 20–26°C days, cold nights. Crowds only at Terelj and at Naadam in the capital. The cost is the car: 4–6 h on dirt roads between stops, so transit hours are high.

blocks.name: Ulaanbaatar
blocks.place: Gandan monastery, National Museum, Chinggis Khaan museum, Zaisan
blocks.history: Mongol empire, Buddhist purges, Soviet satellite
see: Gandan monastery morning chanting
National Museum of Mongolia and the new Chinggis Khaan museum
Choijin Lama temple museum
Zaisan hill and the Bogd Khan winter palace
Naadam stadium (11–13 July) if the dates fit

blocks.name: Naadam in Ulaanbaatar
blocks.place: Opening ceremony, wrestling, archery, horse races at Khui Doloon Khudag
blocks.history: The three manly games since the 13th century
see: Opening ceremony 11 July (tickets through a local agency, months ahead)
Wrestling rounds in the stadium
Horse races on the steppe outside town, children riding
Countryside naadams later in July are smaller and better
blocks.note: Only if the trip starts by 10 July. Hotels triple; the smaller district naadams in late July are quieter and more fun.

blocks.name: Karakorum + Erdene Zuu
blocks.place: Site of the 13th-century capital, 16th-century monastery, museum
see: Erdene Zuu monastery inside its 108 stupas
Karakorum museum (the city reconstructed)
Turtle rocks and the phallic rock
Orkhon valley UNESCO landscape begins here

blocks.name: Orkhon valley
blocks.place: Waterfall, Tövkhön monastery hike, ger family stays, horses
see: Orkhon waterfall and the lava gorge
Tövkhön monastery walk (2,300 m, 2 h up through larch forest)
Two nights with a herder family: milking, airag, horse rides
Eight lakes (Naiman Nuur) for a longer horse trek

blocks.name: Khövsgöl lake
blocks.place: Siberian-blue lake at 1,650 m, taiga, Tsaatan reindeer herders
see: Lakeshore walks and horse rides from Khatgal
Boat on the lake, 2% of the world's fresh water
Tsaatan camp visit (long ride, optional)
Ger camp nights, cold and clear
blocks.note: Fly Ulaanbaatar→Mörön (1.5 h), then 3 h. Mosquitoes in July, gone by mid-August.

blocks.name: Gorkhi-Terelj
blocks.place: Granite valleys 2 h from the capital, Aryabal meditation temple
see: Aryabal temple walk
Turtle rock and the valley trails
Khagiin Khar lake overnight on horseback for the siblings
blocks.note: The busiest park in Mongolia, which still means almost nobody.

blocks.name: Khustai national park
blocks.place: Takhi wild horses at dusk, steppe walks
see: Evening drive and walk to see takhi (Przewalski's horses)
Ungut Turkic memorial stones
Ger camp night

blocks.name: Gobi: Yolyn Am, Khongor dunes, Flaming Cliffs
blocks.place: Ice gorge, 300 m dunes, dinosaur cliffs
see: Yolyn Am gorge walk (ice until July)
Khongoryn Els dune climb at sunset, camels
Bayanzag flaming cliffs
Long drives between each
blocks.note: Hot (32°C) and far: over Mom's heat line and heavy on the car.

blocks.name: Altai Tavan Bogd
blocks.place: Kazakh eagle hunters, glaciers, base camp at 3,100 m
see: Fly to Ölgii, 6 h drive to the park
Walk or ride to the Potanin glacier viewpoint
Eagle hunter family stay
Tsagaan Salaa petroglyphs
blocks.note: The far west; a trip in itself. Altitude fine at 3,100 m, logistics heavy.

notes: July is the wettest month, which means afternoon showers on green steppe, not monsoon. August is drier and clearer.
Nights 3–8°C in the gers; camps supply stoves and blankets.
Mosquitoes around Khövsgöl and the northern lakes in July; none on the central steppe.

lodgingAssumption: Local B&B or Airbnb, two rooms for five, one meal out a day; shared van or hire car
